name: papermeld
description: A Codex Skill and plugin for building, searching, and auditing local catalog-first paper libraries.

interface.shortDescription: Codex Skill for catalog-first local paper libraries.
interface.longDescription: An installable Codex Skill to organize, retrieve, and audit a local literature library without tying it to a research field or PDF converter.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $papermeld to find a small evidence set in my local paper library.
